'''Pauline''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] for {{Quest|If On a Rainy Night a Family}}, found speaking to [[Elisa]] by the [[Montelli Quarter]]'s pool about [[Carlotta]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During {{Quest|If On a Rainy Night a Family}})
:'''Pauline:''' If only I were Lady Carlotta! I'd love to have the power to create gems whenever I wanted!
:'''Pauline:''' They're so dazzling and mesmerizing. If I were her... actually, just giving me the chance to pick them up would be enough, hehe.
:'''Elisa:''' But... don't you know those aren't real gems?
:'''Pauline:''' Wait, really? They're not?
:'''Elisa:''' Nope. Someone who thought they could make a fortune from those "gems" tried, only to find out that they couldn't even sell them, let alone use them for anything useful.
:'''Elisa:''' Those "gems" are actually a medium for deconstruction and reconstruction. They're capable of collapsing and disintegrating the target's frequency they hit before the target vanishes completely.
:'''Elisa:''' So they just look like gems. When needed, they can transform into the shape of firearms or bullets.
:'''Pauline:''' W-well... what happened to those who actually got their hands on them?
:'''Elisa:''' Hard to say. Maybe they ended up as sparkling fragments... Haha.
{{Dialogue End}}
